body:
Intense 20mg DMXE Experience
Prior dissociative experience: Ive only ever tried Ketamine and DXM, both producing a very psychedelic experience at higher doses for me. However the Ketamine use was over a year ago, and I, unfortunately, didnt write a report so I dont remember the experience very clearly. I have no discernable disso tolerance.
Allergy test: ~6mg
No immediate adverse effects noted although a feeling of slight dissociation and lightheadedness seems to be present after 10 minutes. However, at these levels, it could easily be placebo. I also seem to have slightly sweaty palms. Next time I will volumetrically dose my allergy test instead of eyeballing.
Next time I will volumetrically dose my allergy test instead of eyeballing.
Live report: 20mg oral
T+0:00 Dissolved 200mg of weighed slightly-tan DMXE powder in 20ml water, spraying 2ml in my mouth for a 20mg dose. Solution tastes slightly bitter but easy to swallow with some water. Supplemented with Alpha-Lipoic Acid (500mg, antioxidant) an hour earlier to minimize potential neuro-toxicity.
T+0:05 Noticeable increase in saliva production. I remember having this effect on Ketamine as well. I feel hotter than usual but in a nonbothering way. Can't tell if Im wearing too many clothes or if it's the substance. No other effects so far.
T+0:07 Suddenly feeling extremely relaxed. All the muscles in my body feel fully relaxed, and I think it'd be hard to tense up even if I wanted to. Relatively minor mental effects, but there is some dissociation. I would compare the mental effects at this point to a few beers.
T+0:10 The warmness in my head is kind of nice, it feels like a warm blanket. I can still type relatively OK, but I feel it getting slighter harder. If I just stare into nothing and don't do anything the effects are most prominent.
T+0:15 Feeling the first tingle of euphoria, while the dissociation intensity is going up. Feeling extremely at peace and relaxed. I hit an 18mg/ml nicotine vape which temporarily intensified the euphoria further.
T+0:20 Dissociation is extremely obvious now, I'm not sure if I would be able to hold a sober convo atm. I'm going to try to play some Minecraft.
T+0:31  Dissociation and sedation are getting really intense. Its very hard to play properly, so I think Im going to do something else. I feel both anesthetized, dissociated, and relaxed. An amazing combo to be sure. Euphoria is only present when I close my eyes, which also makes me feel like Im in a dream-state. I don't have any visuals, apart from visual snow which is very reminiscent of weed.
T0:39 I just did a cartridge of N2O, and as per usual it just intensified everything. I didnt enjoy it as much as mixing nitrous with other substances, however, so I'm not sure if I recommend the mix. My fingers are starting to feel very weird while typing, kinda like theyre wet even though they aren't. I think it's because of the anesthetic effects as I can't feel my lips or inside of my mouth either. Music sounds much better when it's loud, but it's not as good as on psychedelics.
I think this is the peak.
T+1:01 On the comedown now. Dissociation is still strong, but the sedation is taking over. The fun effects seem for the most part to be over. I'm still feeling very relaxed, and glad I had the experience.
T+1:40 Back to baseline now. Only feeling slight residual effects. My mood is very good though, with what feels like some very noticeable anti-depressant effects which should be further investigated by other researchers.
T+1 day Antidepressant effects are still present and noticeable. Could also be described as an after-glow. However, I suspect the effect will probably fade in a couple of days at most. Very good experience all in all.
Conclusion: Very fun effects, although it did leave me intrigued to try higher doses. It was definitely quite an intense experience
. The main effects for me were feelings of warmness, inner-peace, sedation, and quite intense dissociation.
